title: Result Builder: Tiny HTML DSL
hints: A `@resultBuilder` turns the statements in a closure into calls to `build…` methods.
jsBridge: Result builders turn a block of expressions into a value, which is how SwiftUI's `VStack { Text(); Text() }` works. They're Swift's JSX: a compile-time transform with no runtime parser.

compass.q: JSX compiles to `createElement` calls. What do result builders compile to (`buildBlock`, `buildEither`)?
Why do `if` statements in a builder need `buildEither`/`buildOptional`? What does `for` need?
